text:
deploybot: Rolling v2 -> canary 20% at 14:03 UTC. Automated smoke checks passed, but post-canary telemetry shows a spike in client-side JSON parse errors from mobile SDKs (app crash rate +0.9%).

maya: saw those reports. stacktrace points to `JSON.parse` failing on responses from /v2/generate for some tenants.

devon: do we have an example payload?

qa-bot: attaching sample failed payloads from last 10m:
```
case 1: valid v1 style envelope:
{
  version: 1,
  output: { text: "hi" },
  meta: { request_id: "r-123" }
}

case 2: v2 envelope that broke clients:
{
  version: 2,
  response: { text: "hi" },
  // note: meta moved under response.envelope in some builds
  response.envelope: null
}
```

maya: older mobile parsers expect top-level `meta` object. v2 sometimes returns `response.envelope` instead, and some routing shards are emitting `null` instead of `{}`. app code does `resp.meta.whatever` and crashes.

samir: that sounds like a server-side serialization bug. Which model shard / runtime variant is serving these?

ops: routing tag: region=eu-west shard=ikern-03, runtime=v2-rt-1.2. There was a micro-optimizing serializer landed in the runtime last week (PR #4123).

alejandra: if it's limited to ikern-03 we can pin those shards back to stable runtime while we hotfix. Do we need a global rollback?

devon: scope impact first. QA telemetry shows ~230 unique tenants hit, but 85% are mobile app versions < 2.4.0 which are known to rely on top-level `meta`. Most web clients are fine.

maya: proposal: pause progressive canary (stop further traffic to v2), pin ikern-03 back to v1-rt, add a quick gateway shim to normalize missing `meta` for older clients, and cut a runtime patch to ensure `response.envelope` is never `null` (always `{}`) with `meta` fallback to top-level.

ops: agree with pause and shard pin. Deploybot: can you stop canary advance?

deploybot: canary advance paused at 20% by operator. No further traffic will be shifted.

lin: I'll open a hotfix PR for the runtime serializer now. Quick checklist: add unit test for null vs {} serialization, verify downstream integration tests, and roll patch to ikern-03. ETA ~ 90m if no test regressions.

samir: while lin lands the fix, we should add a temporary gateway normalize patch that maps `response.envelope` -> `meta` for clients that signal `User-Agent` older-than-2.4.0. That avoids client crashes for the next 24-48 hours.

alejandra: ops, can we route ikern-03 into maintenance mode for the patch rollout window?

ops: yes. I'll cordon the node groups and move traffic to healthy v2 shards and v1 for legacy routing. But note: if we divert too much to v1 we may overload v1 capacity. We need to monitor token/sec.

devon: rollback criteria spelled out: if crash rate > 0.5% app-wide for 1h or client parse errors > 0.5% post-pause, we fully rollback canary to v1 for all routes. We'll also set an alert for increase in 5xxs from gateway normalizer.

qa-bot: adding test matrix: mobile <2.4.0, mobile >=2.4.0, web, dedicated customers. Will run against patched runtime and gateway shim.

maya: release notes: add a compatibility note under "Known changes" for v2: "JSON envelope reorganization — servers will populate response.envelope; top-level meta may be absent for new clients. Older SDKs expect top-level meta; see migration guide." Put migration snippet for app teams. Also include rollback contact and pin list.

alejandra: I'll draft the short release note blurb and push to the release-notes PR with a clear callout: "If you are running SDK < 2.4.0, do not upgrade to v2 runtime until you update the SDK or apply gateway shim."

ops: action items:
- pause canary advance (done)
- pin ikern-03 to v1-rt (in progress)
- apply gateway normalizer (pending)
- runtime patch PR #4189 (lin)
- update release notes & customer comms (alejandra)

lin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4189 - adds null-safety and unit tests. Running integration.

samir: will review PR and prioritize merge. If green, we'll deploy to ikern-03 first then uncordon.

devon: can we also capture a sample failing tenant ID list and include in the customer outreach so SEs can preemptively contact impacted customers?

qa-bot: collected tenant samples: t-1337, t-42, t-7700. I'll dump sanitized logs to the release channel.

maya: decision for now: hold canary, pin affected shard(s), deploy gateway shim for old SDKs, aim to reattempt canary advance after successful patch and 2h of no increase in crash rate. If any regression appears, full rollback to v1.

ops: executing shard pin now. Monitoring dashboard: https://dash.redwood/rt/canary/1768904321

deploybot: operator note: canary advance remains paused. Will await explicit +ops signoff to continue.

alejandra: I'll send a short email to SEs and post a blurb to status.redwood about an ongoing canary hold and mitigation steps for impacted customers.

devon: thanks team. keep replies concise here; if anything new, tag @ops or @maya.

lin: working on runtime patch; will report status in ~45m.

ops: pin complete, traffic shifted off ikern-03, watching capacity.

maya: noted. thanks everyone.
